company.description: IMT Care provides an integrated platform for insurance intermediaries, including agents, brokers, and bancassurance. The platform manages insurance, healthcare, and wellness benefits, offering seamless employee benefits management and hassle-free claims processing. It also includes features for finding nearby hospitals and accessing corporate health insurance benefits through a user-friendly app.
